text:
The plate is a square dinner plate of about 24-26 cm, and it spans roughly 430 px in the image. That works out to about 0.058 cm per px.

There are two corn pieces. One is a cob segment lying on its side, about 115 px by 100 px, or roughly 6 cm long and 5 cm across. The other is a cut end, about 90 px across, or roughly 5 cm. Both look like short cob segments about 3-4 cm thick, so I'm treating them as two pieces of cob, together about 5 cm of cob length.

Corn on the cob weighs about 150-200 g per 5 cm segment including the cob. The visible edible kernels are perhaps 60-70% of that. I'll estimate about 2 × 55 g of kernels plus the cob, giving a total of roughly 150 g.

Boiled corn on the cob is about 0.9 kcal/g for kernels, and the whole piece with the cob is closer to 0.6 kcal/g. At 150 g, that comes to about 100 kcal.
